promos.hook: Clarissa, gloating: 'Because he is marrying me.'
promos.cliffhanger: 'Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.'
promos.why: Whole premise with zero prior context: a bride at the altar learns her sister is marrying her fiance, and the family knew.

promos.hook: Clarissa, mocking: 'Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you.'
promos.cliffhanger: 'Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.'
promos.why: Humiliation turned into defiance; works as a standalone clapback with no setup needed.

promos.hook: Blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers, carving bloody gashes.
promos.cliffhanger: Her torn, bloodied hand closes around the emerald signet ring.
promos.why: Wordless physical ordeal, then an object reveal that poses a question without answering it.

promos.hook: A thug shoves Juliana to the ground; blood seeps through her bandages.
promos.cliffhanger: Alexander steps between her and three thugs with cold, deadly intent.
promos.why: Violence opens it, and it cuts before the fight resolves - the viewer needs the outcome.

promos.hook: Whip crack - a noblewoman strikes Juliana across the torso with a riding crop.
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana, cold: 'Let her think I am only a maid.'
promos.why: Physical violence stops the scroll, then a secret-identity tease replaces resolution.

promos.hook: Catherine's enraged scream 'Enough!' as a branding iron sears her mother's book.
promos.cliffhanger: The iron stops inches from Juliana's eyes; macro close-up of the ember in her eye.
promos.why: Pure peril needing no setup, cut mid-threat. Flagged at audit time as the weakest of my picks for standalone comprehension - a stranger is never told her name.
